metadata.title: V2 extraction relational data dictionary
metadata.status: draft for human calibration; no records extracted
metadata.field_count_note: The 61 legacy source fields are retained and mapped; the operational schema adds relational, donor-count, assay-universe, candidate-selection, supplement-traceability and digitization fields.

missing_value_semantics.blank_template_null: Not yet extracted; do not interpret as absent/unreported.
missing_value_semantics.counts: Use integer if reported; after source review use NR, NA or UNCLEAR as string, not null.
missing_value_semantics.identifiers: Primary keys and required linkage keys are assigned stable nonempty IDs, never NR/NA/UNCLEAR. Optional links may be null when inapplicable; unresolved required links remain pending and cannot enter the reconciled dataset.

reports.description: 一篇出版报告或可区分版本；与cohort经桥表关联。

cohorts.description: 一个独立招募来源/参与者集合；同队列跨报告复用cohort_id。
cohorts.row_unit: one recruited participant cohort or separable stratum

report_cohort_links.description: 报告—队列多对多桥接；支持一报告多子研究和一队列多报告。

sample_sets.description: 同一报告/队列/组别 × 矩阵 × assay/platform × 精确采样时间的样本集合；分母不同时拆行。
sample_sets.row_unit: one group × assay/matrix × exact timepoint sample set

measurements.description: 已报告分析物/明确特征集 × 统计比较；只记录原文结果。
measurements.row_unit: One assay-level tested-universe summary OR one named candidate/feature × comparison; include all named immune candidates from original aims/methods regardless of significance.

precision_validation.description: 多维precision/validation长表；每行仅一个维度，不汇总成总分。

extraction_provenance.description: 提取者、独立复核、分歧裁决、AI辅助、数据访问与出版完整性审计。

study_families.description: 独立研究/试验/项目家族；同一试验不同报告共用study_id。

rules: One study_families row may have multiple cohorts.
One report may describe multiple cohorts/studies, and one cohort may produce multiple reports: link through report_cohort_links, never infer independent cohorts from distinct publications alone.
A sample_set is one group × matrix × assay/platform × exact time. Split when n or measurement process differs.
A measurement can be an assay-level tested-universe record or a named-candidate/result record; candidate records share assay_universe_id and link sample_sets.

For assays with large feature spaces, record tested universe and source/availability; enumerate all named immune candidates identified in original aims/methods in accessible article text and supplements without a significance filter. Do not fabricate rows for unnamed/unreported features.
A measurement links all sample_sets used in its contrast with sample_set_ids; marker_series_id links the same marker across identified exercise bouts when evaluating Support B.
Participants, donors, biospecimens, cells, aliquots, timepoints and technical replicates are separate counts; none except unique participant/donor n is an independent human biological n.
precision_validation uses exactly seven parent domains with separate subfacets; domains are descriptive and no total score is computed.
All sample, measurement and precision rows must match an existing report-study-cohort tuple in report_cohort_links; cohort.study_id must agree with that tuple.
report_cohort_links.scope_streams records cohort-specific A/B memberships; one cohort may contribute to both streams and is counted once overall.
Primary and required linkage IDs cannot use missing-value codes; null is allowed in blank templates and optional inapplicable links only.

precision_dimensions.type: seven multidimensional descriptive parent labels with child facets
precision_dimensions.rule: No sum, mean, ranking, readiness score, GRADE synthesis or clinical ranking.

analysis_unit_rules.n_analyzed: Unique people contributing to a defined report-cohort analysis; report_cohort_links.
analysis_unit_rules.n_by_assay_time: One sample_sets row per assay × matrix × group × time; keep participant, biological sample, cell, technical repeat and aliquot counts separate.
analysis_unit_rules.single_cell: Record participant n, donor n and cell n separately. Donor count basis must be explicit; donor-level pseudobulk/mixed inference cannot be inferred from cell number.
analysis_unit_rules.individual_variation: Record repeated baselines, repeat challenges and within-person variance/measurement error; raw pre-post difference alone does not establish reproducible responder status or personalized utility.
analysis_unit_rules.candidate_universe: For each assay, record the tested feature universe and available source files; enumerate every named immune candidate that meets the original aims/methods definition in accessible article/supplements regardless of significance. Never infer unreported nulls.
analysis_unit_rules.figure_values: Use numbers reported in text/tables/supplements first. If later digitization is necessary, predeclare the method and mark as digitized-from-figure; preserve panel locator, independent A/B readings and reconciliation.
analysis_unit_rules.support_B: Require the same marker and same participants across at least two distinct identified exercise-bout IDs, known bout-to-sample timing, and a baseline/comparator.

legacy_mapping_notes.n_by_assay_time: Represent with sample_sets, not a nested assay×time map.
legacy_mapping_notes.exact_times: Preserve source wording plus normalized time from exercise end; time_bin is presentation only.
legacy_mapping_notes.validation: Put each dimension in its own precision_validation row; label co-measurement, association, internal and independent external validation distinctly.
legacy_mapping_notes.provenance: Reviewer/human decisions remain blank until performed.
legacy_mapping_notes.semicolon_targets: Split destination_table and destination_column on semicolons and trim whitespace. Broadcast a single table across multiple columns, or a single column across multiple tables; when both contain multiple targets, pair them positionally. Verify every resulting table.column against the template.

new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.n_donors: Number of unique biological donors contributing to this assay/time sample set; record separately from participants and cells.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.donor_count_basis: Basis used to identify/count biological donors and relation to participant IDs.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.bout_id / bout_number: Distinct identified exercise event and sequence number; required to test Support B across bouts.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.participant_linkage: Whether the same individuals are documented across repeated event sample sets.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.record_type / assay_univers: Distinguish assay-level universe summary from named candidate and reported-result rows; connect rows from one assay universe.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.candidate_selection_rule /: Record candidate selection rule, source in original aims/methods/protocol, and timing. Original aims/methods qualify without preregistration.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.candidate_in_original_aims_: Audit why each named immune candidate enters the map; include regardless of statistical significance.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.supplement_availability / s: Record whether supplementary candidate/feature lists were available and exact links/locations, including inaccessible files.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.feature_total_count / unit: Record total features or candidates in the reported/testing universe and the file/table/accession where it can be checked.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.result_status: Distinguish explicit null/nonsignificant result from a named candidate whose result was not retrievable or not separately reported.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.marker_series_id: Link the same marker across at least two identified exercise bouts for Support B review.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.effect_value_source and dig: Distinguish author-reported values from digitized figure readings; record the predeclared method, panel, two readings and reconciliation.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.linkage_subtype: Functional and clinical linkage remain child facets under one parent domain.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.validation_use_subt: Independent validation and use/impact testing remain child facets under one parent domain.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.tested_universe / n / unit: Explicit assay-level tested feature space/denominator: definition plus count and unit, including platform and QC/filtering rules.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.report_cohort_links.scope_streams: Record applicable A_core_acute and/or B_support_repeated_bouts streams for this report-study-cohort relationship. Both may coexist; deduplicate overall cohort counts. Keep report-level scope_stream as the legacy summary; link-level memberships govern cohort-stratified maps.

immune_link_definition: For biofluid omics, an immune objective/candidate must be identifiable in original study aims or methods; preregistration is not required. Post-hoc immune pathway enrichment alone is context, not sufficient main-map immune linkage.
